context: Hina visits Ren and Aoi to drop off something.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、これ、あおいさんの赤ちゃんに。
lines.en: Brother, this is for Aoi-san's baby.
lines.style: Bright, eager child's voice with genuine warmth. Quick opening, almost breathless with excitement. Soft on the offering—she's proud of her choice. No affectation, pure sincerity throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、ありがとう、ひな。あおい、絶対、喜ぶ。
lines.en: Wow, thanks, Hina. Aoi's going to be so happy.
lines.style: Warm and genuinely moved. A beat of real appreciation before the response. Soft, unhurried pace. The voice of someone touched by a child's kindness—no performing it, just feeling it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、お姉さん、ちゃんと、している！
lines.en: I'm being a big sister properly!
lines.style: High, bright declaration with childish pride. Quick tempo. The lift on the final word—she's showing off a little, seeking validation. Genuine joy, no self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お、立派。本当に、優しいね。
lines.en: Oh, that's really mature of you. You're so kind.
lines.style: Softly appreciative, leaning back slightly. No patronizing lift—genuinely praising. Warm but understated. A quiet moment of recognition passing between them.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃんと、あおいさんの、赤ちゃんも、一緒に、楽しみ！
lines.en: I can't wait to meet the baby with you and Aoi-san!
lines.style: Bright return to excitement, building slightly. Inclusive warmth—she's envisioning them together. Quick, light pace. Trailing off slightly on the final word, savoring the thought.
